description: This file defines a Java interface named GLIMAccountInfoWritePlatformService, which provides method signatures for managing GLIM (Group Loan Individual Monitoring) account states within the loan account service of the FinFineract project. The interface includes methods to accept/reject child accounts, increment child account counts, and create new GLIM accounts with specified parameters.

classes.name: GLIMAccountInfoWritePlatformService
classes.description: A service interface for managing GLIM account information related to group loan accounts, including setting acceptance status, incrementing child accounts, and creating new GLIM accounts.

methods.name: setIsAcceptingChild
methods.description: Sets the GLIM account to accept a child account.

methods.name: resetIsAcceptingChild
methods.description: Resets the GLIM account to no longer accept a child account.

methods.name: incrementChildAccountCount
methods.description: Increments the count of child accounts associated with the GLIM account.

methods.name: createGLIMAccount
methods.description: Creates a new GLIM account with specified account number, group, principal amount, child accounts count, acceptance status, loan status, and application ID.
